The lightning misses the knight, but his health bar drops by half.
His shield is untouched. The pillar took the hit.
He runs. Another bolt lands behind him. One HP left.
Wait. If it keeps missing, what is hurting him?
You see, lightning doesn't need a direct hit. Its current spreads through the ground.
Boots on two different voltages let current pass through his body.
His shield was useless. So he equipped the whole castle.
